## Story

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

A mother butterfly lands on a green leaf. She lays a tiny pale egg. The egg clings to the underside of the leaf.

</div>

<div class="reader-sidebar">

</div>

<div class="reader-sidebar">

### Spelling Aid

**Phonograms on this page:** a, c, d, e, f

</div>

</div>

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

The caterpillar is hungry. It eats and eats the soft green leaf. It grows so quickly that its skin becomes too tight.

</div>

<div class="reader-sidebar">

### Spelling Aid

</div>

<div class="reader-text">

</div>

<div class="reader-sidebar">

### Spelling Aid

**Phonograms on this page:** a, b, c, d, e

</div>

</div>

<div class="reader-page">

</div>

<div class="reader-sidebar">

### Spelling Aid

**Phonograms on this page:** a, c, d, e, f

</div>

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

**Phonograms on this page:** a, b, c, d, e

</div>

## Think About It

1. What is the first stage of a butterfly's life? (A tiny pale egg on a leaf.) 2. What happens inside the chrysalis? (The caterpillar dissolves and new parts form — wings, legs.) 3. Find Stage 4 Latin /sh/ PGs. (special uses 'ci' → /sh/: s-pe-cial. uncurl also has 'ci'.)
